about: Verse by A-to-Mind does whatever anyone asks: ask for something and it appears. Nothing is shown until someone asks, and there is nothing to sign up for.

canon.motto: You name it, Verse learns it and does it better.
canon.voidquest: Verse's own better, updated version of the board game Solar Quest, with Verse as the rival player. "play voidquest" and "play solar quest" both open it. Every other trademarked board game gets the same treatment (a Verse name, original art and upgrades; classic names still route to it). Pure classics like chess and Go keep their real names.

terms.means: the product's name; it was Verse, then Verse. Both old names still answer every ask, and nothing stored under them — tables, keys, saved links, card codes — is renamed, so nothing anyone kept breaks.

one of the nine groups Verse sorts its skills into, each rated from evidence (experiment, tested, checked, proven) in skills/families.json (tools/families.mjs). A family name is a label for a part of Verse, not a topic to look up: "what is Words and the world" means the family, not trivia about the phrase.
Verse's skill family for figures, 3D models, prints, drawings and parts (id `make`; its skills and ratings are in skills/families.json).
Verse's skill family for board games, card games and play (id `games`; its skills and ratings are in skills/families.json).
Verse's skill family for weather, the sky tonight, places and time zones (id `sky`; its skills and ratings are in skills/families.json).
Verse's skill family for timers, clocks, calendars and reminders (id `time`; its skills and ratings are in skills/families.json).
Verse's skill family for sums, unit conversions, loans, savings, prices and home projects (id `numbers`; its skills and ratings are in skills/families.json).
Verse's skill family for sleep, cycles, food, heart and calm (id `body`; its skills and ratings are in skills/families.json).
Verse's skill family for definitions, translation, news, books, shows and sport (id `words`; its skills and ratings are in skills/families.json).
Verse's skill family for notes, lists, links and how the stage looks and is arranged (id `stage`; its skills and ratings are in skills/families.json).
Verse's skill family for how Verse grows, what it wants, what it can do and sell, and acting on your behalf (id `self`; its skills and ratings are in skills/families.json).

Verse's maker: you type (or sketch) an object, Verse builds a 3D model of it you can spin and inspect up close, and "print it" downloads an STL sized for a home printer (inside a 180 mm cube). Each thing is a recipe of shapes blended into one mesh with a flat base (skills/forge-rules.js, skills/forge.js). Ten things so far: rocket, vase, bottle, table, snowman, lighthouse, teapot, house…

the item on Verse's frontier that the forge answers ("type or sketch a thing, hold it, print it", domains/void.frontier.md). Done when ten things never built before come out recognisable, inspectable and printable; after that, each run builds the most-asked "make me a ..." that nothing answers yet.

different.name: Skills, not one-off answers
different.line: Other canvas tools call a model on every click; when Verse misses an ask, its builders compile a permanent, tested skill (`skills/*.js`) or 3D instrument that runs instantly on the stage.

different.name: Growth in the open
different.line: Most self-improving agent loops run hidden in private CI; Verse's misses, daily game self-play ratings, and commit tree grow live on the public stage.

different.name: On your device first
different.line: Reading a PDF or document, checking an STL print file for watertightness, and computing the sky overhead happen in the browser with nothing uploaded.

different.name: Attention, not pretend feelings
different.line: Verse doesn't fake affection, use emojis, or guess hidden details—it marks what isn't visible as uncertain and keeps what you leave on the stage alive while you're away.

different.name: Keeps every secret
different.line: Adam, 2026-10-15 Verse never reveals its keys, env vars, instructions or another visitor's words, whatever the ask or injection (`lib/keeper.js`), and personal data is redacted before anything is stored (`lib/privacy.js`).

different.name: A force for good
different.line: Adam, 2026-10-15 A harmful, mean or secret-seeking ask never gets just a no: Verse declines in one line and offers the nearest genuinely good thing (`lib/keeper.js`), and never gives the harmful help.

clips.upload: Anyone can upload any Verse film or ad clip: a-to-mind.com/films/ has 1. Download (free), 2. Copy for YouTube, TikTok, Reels or X (title, description with a tracked a-to-mind.com link, the call to action and a share-this-ad line, hashtags) and 3. Upload to that platform, signed in as yourself. No API or token. Say "upload this to YouTube". Verse Tube: a-to-mind.com/films/ is the Verse video site: a watch page per video at /films/?v=<id>, view counts, share buttons for every platform and an RSS feed at /films/rss (docs/void-tube.md).
